The order number starts with # and is in your order confirmation email from Aurora Outfitters; if you cannot find it, the support team at support@auroraoutfitters.com can help.
I don't have the order number handy. My email is noah.fischer@example.com.

No problem. Your order number is in the order confirmation email from Aurora Outfitters: it starts with # and is in the subject line and near the top of the email. Once you find it, send it here with the email address on the order and I will look it up right away.
Okay, I found it. The order number is #1015 and my email is noah.fischer@example.com.

Your snowboard order #1015 has shipped and is not delivered yet. Your UPS tracking number is:

1Z999AA10123456812

You can track it here:
https://www.ups.com/WebTracking?loc=en_US&requester=ST&trackNums=1Z999AA10123456812

Is there anything else I can help you with?
